answer: Operator lien pooling. Every agent identity carries a shared anchor: a pooled deposit drawn from the operator's registered treasury, not the wallet. Each new identity raises the pool's required reserve by a fixed margin, so N identities multiply the operator's locked capital linearly. A terrace of reviewable audit tiers lets honest operators grow slowly while flagging farms. Any identity proven sybil stains the whole pool with a pigment of liability: the operator's reserve is slashed and future registrations throttled. Attacker cost is the full reserve per farm, unrecoverable.
